text:
Elliot B: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's multi-vendor degradation (cloud IAM throttles -> model-registry quorum drop). I sketched a short action list and uploaded a heatmap of retry spikes: https://tracker.redwood/actions/V-9021. Need owners + ETAs.

Rashmi D: grabbing the model-registry replica fallback + snapshot plan. I'll prototype a read-through cache with snapshot fallback and a small on-disk immutable blob for critical hashes. ETA: 2026-02-11.

Noah P: i'll take auth-side hardening: add strict retry budgets, jittered exponential backoff, and a per-caller circuit-breaker. will also add auth_retry_ratio alert and a 95/99 tail-auth-latency dashboard. ETA: 2026-02-08.

Helena W: security/runbook owner here 1: any snapshot or local cache must be encrypted (KMS), have file-level ACLs, and include a CVM (cache validity matrix) doc. i'll own runbook updates and the pre-deploy security checklist. ETA: 2026-01-31.

ops-bot: Created follow-ups: V-9021-1 (registry-cache), V-9021-2 (auth-retries), V-9021-3 (runbook+kms). Owners must update tracker within 48h.

Elliot B: Observations from the postmortem: we saw a ~20% regression in tail latency correlated with midnight credential refresh windows and a model-registry replica quorum loss; clients retried aggressively which amplified IAM throttles. Short-term mitigations: small in-process TTL cache, conservative retry budgets, and a soft-routing policy to prefer local dedicated variants for 300ms before cross-region failover.

Rashmi D: cache design notes: bounded LRU, TTL=15s for metadata, max_entries=8k, exclude presigned URLs and secrets. fallback snapshot is read-only, gzipped, and versioned. will add an integration test that simulates 5xx -> snapshot.

Noah P: proposed retry config (will open PR and link it):

```
# auth client
retry_policy: exponential
initial_backoff_ms: 250
max_retries: 2
max_backoff_ms: 2000
jitter: true
circuit_breaker: failures=6, window=45s
```
This should cap amplification while preserving some transient retries.

Helena W: also adding a short checklist for any cache touching model manifests: encryption=true, least-privilege ACL, signed snapshot manifest, and a post-deploy KMS rotation step.

Elliot B: vendor escalation: please include vendor ticket ID in the tracker. I already opened one: IAM-VEND-9012 — add updates there. Also ask vendor for per-minute throttle thresholds and a mitigation plan.

Noah P: added IAM-VEND-9012 to the tracker and noted the vendor SLA question. I'll paste vendor responses.

Rashmi D: added PR link and unit + integration tests to V-9021-1, marking in_progress.

Elliot B: ops governance for these follow-ups:
- require a secondary owner for actions > 72h
- add estimated hours and weekly check-ins if ETA > 7d
- tag any cross-team changes with "ops-review-required"
- add a recurring monthly "vendor-dep resilience" checkpoint to the incident cadence

Helena W: confirming runbook + kms changes. i'll also add a short runbook section on quantifying retry amplification (how to read the heatmap). ETA for docs: 2026-01-30.

Noah P: i'll instrument auth_retry_ratio_by_service and add alert thresholds (warn @ 20/min, page @ 60/min). will wire alerts to vendor-resilience channel.

Elliot B: schedule: 15m sync tomorrow to validate ETAs and confirm vendor ticket updates. Owners please comment in the tracker with final ETA by EOD. :thumbsup:

Rashmi D: confirmed, will update tracker.

Noah P: confirmed, PR in ~4h.

Helena W: confirmed docs ownership.

Elliot B: thanks all — i'll consolidate notes after the sync and add a short blurb to the leadership weekly about the recurring pattern and next steps. :white_check_mark:
